tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ rgyun 'khyer shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so//

bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas// blo dman chos la mos pa dang*// gzhan dbang g.yeng bas brel rnams la// rgyun 'khyer chag med 'di skad gdam// bde ba'i stan 'dug 'di skad brjod/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs yi dam srung ma la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi| |bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la sman slad sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /gsum bya/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ gnyis 'dzin gdos bcas chos sbyangs stong pa'i ngang*// bdud bzhi'i gdan la rang rig hūm̐ dmar las// byung ba'i bla ma bde ba'i rdo rje ni// mdog dmar phyag gnyis rdor dril yum la 'khyud// brkyang bskum rus pa'i phyag rgya drug brgyan cing*// dar dang rin chen rgyan 'chang thor tshugs can// yum mchog stong nyid rdo rje byu ru'i mdog /gri thod 'dzin cing 'khril sbyor ral pa bsnyil// yab yum gar dgu'i nyams ldan 'od zer 'bar// yab kyi dpral bar nyi zla'i gdan steng du// thub dbang mtshan dpe yongs rdzogs rdor skyil bzhugs| |mgrin par zla nyi'i gdan la rdo rje 'chang*// rdor dril bsnol 'dzin rang 'dra'i yum dang sbyor// longs sku nges pa lnga ldan mtshan dpe rdzogs| |thugs kar nyi zla'i gdan la 'jig rten mgon// dkar po chos gos gsum ldan rdor skyil bzhugs// chos 'khor phyag rgya bka' rtags sgom zhwa mnabs// thugs kar zla steng rtsa ba'i bla ma ni// da lta'i cha lugs ji bzhin 'od du 'bar// thugs kar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i// lte bar oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing rnams// brtsegs mar gnas pa ye shes lnga yi dngos// lha rnams kun gyi gnas gsum yi ge gsum/ 'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs gnyis med bstim// slar yang 'od 'phros dbang lha spyan drangs nas// mchod cing gsol btab dbang lhas dbang bskur bas| |chu yis lus gang sgrib sbyangs lhag ma las// rigs lngas dbu brgyan dbang lha rang la bstim// lha sngags sa bon bcas las 'od 'phros pas// phyogs bcu'i rgyal mchod thugs rje bsdus la thim// 'od kyis 'gro drug sgrib sbyangs bla ma yi/ */go 'phang la bkod kun kyang sngags sgra sgrog

/gzugs snang sku la sgra grag rdo rje'i bzlas// dran rtogs thugs su gdod nas yongs su grub// oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes rdor bzlas brgya phrag bya/ thub dbang 'od zhu rdo rje 'chang la thim// de yang 'od zhur 'jig rten mgon po la// de nyid rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim zhing*// de yang rdo rje rdo rje sngags gsum la// sngags gsum steng nas rim bsdus hūm̐ la thim// hūm̐ yig zhabs kyu khog pa mgo zla tshes// thig le nā da rim bzhin dmigs med gyur// bde ba'i rdo rje'i spyi bor haṃ dkar po// thur bstan gsang bar a shad dmar po bsam// rlung gis sbar bas a shad me lce yis// lus ngag nyes sgrib bsregs shing haṃ la reg /haṃ las dkar cha 'o ma ltar zags pa// me lce dang 'dres dkar dmar bde drod kyis// lus gang bde stong ye shes rgyas par bsam// rdor bzlas brgya phrag bya zhing slar yang ni/ bde ba'i rdo rje stod smad 'od du zhu// dmigs med 'ja' tshon mkha' ru yal ba ltar// dus gsum rtog med ma bcos rang gshis babs// mtha' bral mnyam yangs chos sku'i ngo bor grol// de las byung dang 'khor 'das yod pa'i dge// kun mkhyen sa bon 'khor gsum yongs dag tshogs// dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs rab dkar ba// 'gro rnams byang chub thob phyir bsngo bar bgyi// zhes brjod 'don sgom zung 'jug lam bsdus 'di// blo dman rnams kyis zhogs sam dgong mo'ang rung*// nyin zhag re la lan re ma chag pas// bla sgrub chag med dam tshig nges par 'tsho// 'di yang blo dman chos 'dod che ba'am| |lam la mos kyang gzhan dbang g.yeng ba yis// rnam par brel la mdor bsdus 'di byas kyi// blo gros ldan zhing rnam g.yeng 'ga' med par// dka' tshegs la bsam las sla 'khyer bde dang*// des chog des 'ong rgyu dal la bsams nas// rgyas pa'i lam dor bsdus pa la dga' zhing*// de yi 'dod ngor bla mas 'di byin na// dam med slob dpon slob ma de dag gi// snying khrag 'thung zhig dam can srung ma'i tshogs// zhes pa'ang blo dman 'jug bde ma bgyis na// lam la mos kyang blo gros dman pa 'ga'// 'don cha mang phyir zab lam spangs kyi dogs// chos kyi grags pas gzu bor bris pa la// nyes tshogs mchis na chos bdag rnams la 'chag
/dge bas don gnyis lhun grub dpal thob shog/ //siddhi rastu//
